Still useful, but outcomes improve a lot when you add CAD, automation, data, or product thinking.

Good when you care about the physical world. Do not choose it only because it feels familiar.

items.heading: The Title Trap
items.text: The title trap. Students choose a respected title first and only later ask whether they can actually live that career.

items.heading: The Exam Trap
items.text: The exam trap. JEE or NEET preparation starts before the student has properly tested fit, cost, or long-term interest.

items.heading: The College Trap
items.text: The college trap. Families prepare to spend heavily before understanding which specific role the degree should lead to.
